style: Stylized rendered population stages from sparse settlements to dense skylines on matching 2:1 ground diamonds

stages.name: empty-region
stages.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original empty-region terrain painting for a city-building game UI. The supplied image is a rendering-style reference only; do not copy its island silhouette. IMPORTANT: output an opaque rectangular image with a 2:1 width-to-height ratio, entirely filled edge to edge with continuous softly varied muted sage-green meadow grass. No sky, no horizon, no black or transparent areas, no floating island, no bevel, no foundation, no surrounding void, no cast shadow at the edge. This painting will later be cropped to a mathematically exact 2:1 diamond; the top, bottom, left and right midpoints are the diamond corners. Treat that diamond as a very large mostly empty regional land tile, NOT a close-up garden. Same scale across all settlement stages. Orthographic game view, ground axes slope exactly 1 up for 2 across, vertical objects upright. Polished stylized rendered illustration, softly painted surfaces, not photographic. Inside the central 20 percent of the frame only: one very small blue-green natural pond, three tiny low trees and a few tiny shrubs. The outer 30 percent border is uninterrupted grass texture, no plants or rocks crossing any image edge or projected diamond edge. Subtle grass texture with very little contrast and broad detail, calm natural greens, no orange or marble. No buildings, streets, text, labels, icon borders or map lines. Light softly from upper left. This is the uninhabited region image; most of it must look like empty land.

stages.name: village
stages.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied opaque meadow painting to make one population-stage illustration in a coherent city-builder UI set. Preserve the full rectangular 2:1 canvas, the exact camera, grass color/texture, lighting, and every pixel outside the central settlement area as closely as possible. Do not turn the grass into an isolated island. This source will be cropped to an exact 2:1 diamond connecting the four edge midpoints. Keep all buildings, trees, paths and shadows inside that diamond and well away from its four diagonal boundaries. Ground lines use the game's 2:1 isometric projection; vertical walls stay upright. No rotation of the image, no camera tilt, no perspective convergence, no sky, no text or labels. Polished stylized rendered buildings with sage, dusty-blue and warm-gray painted facades, slate roofs, restrained stone and brick. No all-white-marble town and no orange-brick palette. This represents a LARGE REGION, so every house is a tiny model and most of the frame remains undeveloped meadow. Replace the central pond/trees as needed to place the settlement; preserve the surrounding grass. The lower quarter of the diamond must remain clear grass for overlaid labels. Deliver one opaque rectangular image, not a contact sheet.
FEWER THAN 2,000 inhabitants: just TWO TINY modest cottages, one small tree and one short narrow dirt lane. The ENTIRE house cluster occupies only about 8 to 10 percent of the image width (about 45 pixels in the final 512-pixel-wide tile), centered slightly above the exact center. The houses are small flecks in a large empty region, NOT big dollhouses filling the tile. No fences, gardens full of flowers, apartment blocks, paved plaza, civic buildings or many trees. More than 90 percent of the diamond looks like uninterrupted grass.

stages.name: huge-city
stages.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: neighbor population-stage artwork for a city-building game. Input image 1 is the edit target and rendering/camera/color reference. Keep the exact same opaque rectangular 2:1 canvas, isometric camera, continuous meadow texture, background green color, illumination and vertical wall direction. Replace only the settlement with the requested much larger population stage. Polished stylized rendered game illustration matching the reference, not photography, no white-marble city and no predominantly orange brick/stone. Render ground axes at exactly 2 across for 1 up. No rotation or perspective convergence. Final bake cuts terrain to a 2:1 diamond joining the four edge midpoints; put streets and building bases inside that ground diamond. Preserve complete building silhouettes, keep skyline within the image frame and give the top of the central towers room beneath the top edge. Surrounding meadow must be continuous edge to edge; no background void, island border, slab, shadow around image edge, sky, horizon, text, labels or watermark. Keep the bottom quarter mostly open grass. Deliver ONE image, not a grid.
Population stage: 500,000–999,999 inhabitants. Replace the small historic town with a clearly BIG CITY: about fifty tiny buildings on a compact connected street grid, densely packed midrise residential blocks and a distinct central skyline with about eight 12-to-20-story office towers. The developed ground footprint is roughly 65 to 70 percent of the image width, far wider than the reference settlement. Buildings are small-scale architectural miniatures distributed across a LARGE region, not individually giant enlarged buildings. Mix slate-roofed older lowrise perimeter housing with modern charcoal, dusty-blue glass, sage and warm-gray midrises. Leave a green perimeter and clear grass in the bottom quarter for UI labels. Clearly intermediate between a town of 100,000 and a million-person megacity.

foreground.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the supplied city image. Extract ONLY the standing vertical objects (every building including complete roofs, spires and facades, plus trees and shrubs) onto a genuinely transparent background. Remove ALL flat ground: meadow, grass, roads, paths, plazas, paving, fountains, ground shadows and sky. Preserve the exact 2:1 canvas size, exact positions, scale, camera, colors and details of ALL standing objects. Do not recenter, crop, shrink, redraw, rotate or rearrange the city. This is a registered foreground layer for this exact image: each building must stay at the same pixel location and be complete from roof to its base. Keep antialiased silhouette edges. Transparent pixels everywhere between and outside the extracted standing objects. No new buildings, no new terrain or border, no text, no watermark. One transparent PNG foreground layer.

source_geometry: Opaque 2:1 scene paintings. Bake the whole frame with the shared ground stencil; stages with extracted foregrounds composite those intact onto stage 0 terrain at the specified width.

0.role: Rendering-style reference for the replacement meadow painting

1-5.role: Edit target; preserve surrounding meadow and camera

6-7.role: Edit target and reference for expanded city stages; extract transparent foregrounds, then compose onto stage 0 terrain
